name: boom
recipe: Sine sub sweeping 55->30 Hz (tau 0.18 s) under a 0.25 s noise burst low-passed 1400->110 Hz, tanh soft-clip.
used_for: Tank shell hit (0 dB), door blast (0 dB), containment gate shutter boom (-2 dB).

name: small_boom
recipe: Same _boom recipe smaller: sub 90->48 Hz tau 0.09 s, 0.16 s noise low-passed 900->160 Hz.
used_for: Relief vent letting go when the junction gauge peaks and the breaker trips (-2 dB).

name: clank
recipe: 40 ms 420 Hz square ring (tau 12 ms) plus a 5 ms noise tick.
used_for: Breaker, junction autosave, clamp release, bolt arc, tank hit/miss/rehung, valve turn and relay spark contact, at pitches 0.55-2.2.

name: thud
recipe: 80 ms 60 Hz sine (tau 30 ms) plus a 300 Hz low-passed noise knock (tau 10 ms).
used_for: Tank miss landing (-3 dB, 0.8), fail-beat knockdown (0 dB, 0.9), seal door landing (-2 dB, 1.1).

name: hiss
recipe: 0.5 s loop of white noise low-passed at 3 kHz with one 2 Hz amplitude wobble per loop. Seam check: no click, but the 0.5 s noise pattern repeats twice a second.
used_for: Junction pressure-line loop, -28 to -8 dB with the gauge; stopped by the door blast.

name: hiss_loop10s
recipe: The in-game hiss loop buffer tiled to 10 s (seams marked yellow in the PNG). Seam check: no click, but the 0.5 s noise pattern repeats twice a second.
used_for: Seam audition for: Junction pressure-line loop, -28 to -8 dB with the gauge; stopped by the door blast.

name: hum
recipe: 1 s loop: 110 Hz + 113 Hz saws through a 500 Hz one-pole low-pass. Seam check: CLICKS once per loop (jump 0.567 vs 0.0055 median step) because the low-pass state restarts at 0.
used_for: Junction pump loop, -16 to -9 dB and pitch 0.5-0.8 with the gauge.

name: hum_loop10s
recipe: The in-game hum loop buffer tiled to 10 s (seams marked yellow in the PNG). Seam check: CLICKS once per loop (jump 0.567 vs 0.0055 median step) because the low-pass state restarts at 0.
used_for: Seam audition for: Junction pump loop, -16 to -9 dB and pitch 0.5-0.8 with the gauge.

name: arc
recipe: 0.5 s randomly gated high-passed (1.2 kHz) crackle decaying 0.12 s plus a 60 ms zap falling 2.4 kHz->500 Hz.
used_for: Records exit arc (-3 dB), exit bolt arc (0 dB), relay spark crackle (-8 dB, 1.2).

name: klaxon
recipe: Three 120 ms 880 Hz square chirps 40 ms apart with 4/8 ms ramps, low-passed at 2.5 kHz.
used_for: Seal-charged warning on a junction valve turn (-4 dB).

name: growl
recipe: 70->58 Hz saw plus breath noise, 900 Hz low-pass, 9 Hz tremolo, 80 ms swell and 0.2 s die-away.
used_for: WOLF's growl at the lane choice (-9 dB at 1.5 or -8 dB) and when he reads the seam (-6 dB).

name: servo
recipe: 1 s loop: 1.2 kHz sine with +/-30 Hz 6 Hz vibrato plus a 0.3 sub-octave; whole cycles per second. Seam check: clean (seam step equals a normal sample step).
used_for: Sentry motor loop, -22/-19/-16 dB at pitch 1.0/1.15/1.4 by sentry state; faded after the tank hit.

name: servo_loop10s
recipe: The in-game servo loop buffer tiled to 10 s (seams marked yellow in the PNG). Seam check: clean (seam step equals a normal sample step).

name: winch
recipe: 1 s loop: 90 Hz saw through a 700 Hz one-pole low-pass with a 7 Hz 25% wobble. Seam check: CLICKS once per loop (jump 0.440 vs 0.0032 median step) because the low-pass state restarts at 0.

name: winch_loop10s

name: corridor_bed10s
recipe: Ventilation: 900 Hz LP noise + 2.5k air band + 320 Hz duct band-pass (Q1.5), +/-20% drift; tones 60/120 Hz mains, 87.5+88 Hz fan blade-pass beating at 0.5 Hz, 175 Hz. 5 chunks x 2 s chained from a shuffle bag (order [1, 4, 2, 3, 0, 1]) with 0.25 s equal-power crossfades; tail wraps into head; generated in 380 ms.
used_for: Corridor room tone bed.

name: records_bed10s
recipe: Dry electrical hush: 1.5-6 kHz soft hiss + trace brown noise + sparse 3-5.5 kHz micro-crackle, +/-10% drift; transformer buzz 60/120/180/240/360 Hz with 120.5 Hz beat. 5 chunks x 2 s chained from a shuffle bag (order [1, 0, 3, 2, 4, 1]) with 0.25 s equal-power crossfades; tail wraps into head; generated in 356 ms.
used_for: Records Access room tone bed (dead, dry room).

name: junction_bed10s
recipe: Big metal drone: brown rumble + 220 Hz LP + 140 Hz (Q4) and 660 Hz (Q8) bands through a 29 ms feedback comb (0.55), +/-25% drift; tones 41+41.5/82.5 Hz and metal partials 137.5/211/389.5/523 Hz. 5 chunks x 2 s chained from a shuffle bag (order [1, 0, 3, 2, 4, 1]) with 0.25 s equal-power crossfades; tail wraps into head; generated in 472 ms.
used_for: Service Junction room tone bed.

name: distant_bang
recipe: Hull modes 48/71/113/167/239 Hz (tau 0.25-0.9 s) + low noise knock, low-passed 600 Hz, reflections at 140 and 310 ms.
used_for: Distant hull bang one-shot for any room's scheduler (corridor hull knocks).

name: drip
recipe: Impact tick + bubble chirp rising ~1.1->2.4 kHz (tau 18 ms) + quieter repeat at 112 ms + faint wash.
used_for: Junction drips near the wet deck.

name: pipe_creak
recipe: Stick-slip pulse train wandering 38->70->45 Hz through band-passes at 420 Hz (Q12), 1.15 kHz (Q15), 2.3 kHz (Q10), swell in/out.
used_for: Junction pipe/pressure creaks (thin out after door_blown).

name: cooling_tick
recipe: Three irregular ticks: 0.6 ms noise click + modes 2.9/4.1/6.3 kHz and a 900 Hz body.
used_for: Metal cooling ticks, e.g. after the blast or near warm machinery.

name: vent_flutter
recipe: 1.4 kHz low-passed noise chopped by a flap rate falling 22->14 Hz, 500 Hz body, 980 Hz tin knock per beat.
used_for: Corridor/junction vent flutter.

name: relay_click
recipe: Armature click with bounces at 6 and 9 ms (1.8/3.3 kHz modes) + 160 ms 120 Hz coil buzz, low-passed 3.5 kHz for distance.
used_for: Records relay ticks; stop once the corridor relay is set.

name: rustle
recipe: Two handling gestures of dense 1.2-7 kHz noise grains (0.5-3 ms, sine-shaped density) over soft friction hiss.
used_for: Paper/evidence sheet taken or put into the case.

name: clack
recipe: Insert click then louder seat click 45-60 ms later: hard tick + plastic modes 1.05/2.35/3.9 kHz + 260 Hz body.
used_for: Data cartridge seated in the case slot.

name: clink
recipe: Free-bar modes 1:2.756:5.404:8.933 from ~1.1 kHz (tau 0.35-0.05 s) struck, then two smaller detuned bounces.
used_for: Metal tag or tool set down in the case.

name: ratchet
recipe: Six pawl clicks ~65 ms apart: noise tick + modes 1.65/2.6/4.3 kHz climbing 2% per tick + faint 5.2 kHz spring ring.
used_for: Ratchet clicks per hold tick when a tool is used at a station / case latch.
